svg.text: DWG-27-001_socket_frame SOCKET FRAME, 6061-T6 TOP-HAT, 4 OFF (one program, one fixture)
aperture W x H (in land plane)................470.0 x 208.0
1. All socket/hatch border offsets are measured OUTWARD FROM THE APERTURE EDGE and are shared with the module, seal, shell cut and checks (cad/geom.py).
2. Bushing pair true position 0.05 to datum A-B; land flatness 0.3.
3. Rib thickness 3.00 +/-0.05 is a DD6139 grip dimension (1.52-3.18), not cosmetic.
4. Limiter bosses: top = n -13.40 +0/-0.05 with the 7.40 pad; they set the seal compression.
NOT RELEASED FOR FABRICATION. Uncalibrated against the physical vehicle. No FEA performed.
